_comment: The backlog tools/dolibarr/sync-pm.sh rolls into the ERP. Copy this file to
pm-spec.json, which is gitignored because the real backlog names people and
links private documents, and these repositories are going public.
A project is matched by its exact title, a task by its exact label and a
ticket by its exact subject within its project, so renaming any of them
creates a second record rather than renaming the first one. Only the fields
an entry names are written; everything else on the record is left as the UI
has it. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Nothing is ever deleted.
Tickets carry the backlog, because their severity is the priority the UI
shows. A ticket's message is plain text with \n line breaks. severity, type
and category are codes of the ERP's ticket dictionaries, and assignee is a
user login. ticket_defaults fills in whatever a new ticket's entry leaves out,
and an existing ticket gets no defaults.
A ticket entry with a ref is matched by that ref in any project, so its
subject and its project can change. status is open, closed or canceled.
dictionaries maintains ticket_types, ticket_severities and ticket_categories
entries by code, before any ticket is written. status and dictionaries need
